# The e2e virtual screen is too small for the multi-window journeys

## Context

#19657's class probe of the popup group ([analysis](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19657#issuecomment-6130780202)). `--screen-info={1920x1080}` came from `#19288`, which replaced headless Chrome's 800×600 default because the window manager clamps script-moved popups into the screen.

## The Problem

At 1920×1080, the journeys that drive a popup beside a 1280×720 main window still run out of screen. The window manager refuses or clamps the popup's moves.

`WorkstationDragAffordancesNL:388` drives its re-exited vessel to about (1620, 1010):
- alone, every `window.moveTo` was refused, and its own guard skips the test ("native pointer-follow is stage-bound here");
- in the full tier the moves were clamped, so the test failed with `{x: 114, y: 0}` against the expected `{x: 120, y: 70}`.

One-runner A/Bs, interleaved, comparing a 1920×1080 screen with a 2560×1440 one:

| Test | 1920×1080 | 2560×1440 |
|---|---|---|
| `WorkstationDragAffordancesNL:388` ([run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38297274450)) | skipped 3/3 | passed 3/3 |
| `WorkstationFilmTourNL:302` ([run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38297993405)) | 0/2 | 2/2 |
| `WorkstationFilmTourNL:223` | 0/2 | 1/2 |
| `WorkstationNL:2604` | 0/2 | 2/2 |

The FilmTour file also ran in 2.5–4.7 min instead of 7. Its failures waited out 200 s receipts.

`WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL:148`, `WorkstationPopOutPaneIdentityNL`, `LegacyPopupReturnNL` and `WorkstationPopOutSparklinesNL:74` were red at similar rates on both screens, so their causes lie elsewhere (#19657).

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/e2e/utils/gpuIntent.mjs` `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS` is the one launch-argument list, for every e2e tier and local runs.
- The specs that read the screen adapt to it:
  - `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` takes its wide branch from 980 px;
  - `DockPlacementNL` asserts placement inside the screen.
- The specs that set 1920×1080 set the viewport or `contextOptions.screen`, not the window manager's bounds.

## The Fix

Set `--screen-info={2560x1440}` and update the JSDoc's reason.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS` gives headless Chrome a 2560×1440 screen, and the JSDoc says why: the multi-window journeys need room beside a 1280×720 window.
- [ ] A hosted Brain-gated sample with this change shows no new red against the previous sample, and `WorkstationDragAffordancesNL:388` runs instead of skipping.
- [ ] The engine tier is green on the PR.

## Out of Scope

- Dropping FilmTour's quarantine entries: that follows a dedicated run once this lands.
- The other popup-group causes (#19657).
